text:
Kathy owns the condominium outright by survivorship under the tenancy by the entirety created by Bill’s deed, and that gift stands apart from the prenuptial waiver of marital rights. Tommy takes the pasture land under the will, and Tommy and Julie split the rest of the estate. The prenuptial agreement waives Kathy’s pretermitted-spouse, elective-share, and homestead claims, so she takes nothing more from the probate estate.

CONFIDENCE: 90
